LanguageData.Gun_Thompson_M1928A1_RWP.label: Thompson M1928A1
LanguageData.Gun_Thompson_M1928A1_RWP.description: The Thompson M1928A1 is a vintage submachine gun known for its iconic design and rapid rate of fire. Often associated with prohibition-era gangsters and WWII soldiers alike, it delivers a high volume of .45 ACP rounds with reasonable accuracy at short to medium range. However, its heavy weight and considerable recoil require skill to wield effectively.
